subject: OpenForge: Redwood integration demo & webhook/GHE questions
messages:
From: Linus Park <linus@openforge.dev>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: OpenForge: Redwood integration demo & webhook/GHE questions

Hi Soojin,

We did a quick self-serve signup and poked around Redwood's hosted API and the GitHub connector docs. We're an open-source maintainer org (OpenForge) and have a few integration questions before we commit to a demo:

- We run a private GHE cluster behind the corporate firewall. Does the GitHub connector support webhook delivery to a proxy or tunnel? Any docs on GHE installation patterns?
- Can you outline the expected traffic profile for a repo with ~3k active PRs (rough per-minute webhook rate)?
- We're most interested in demoing the GitHub app and webhook handling. Could we get a technical attendee (solutions engineer) on the call?

I can be available next week in these windows (PST):
- Tue Jan 18: 09:00–12:00 PST
- Wed Jan 19: 13:00–16:00 PST

I've attached a pointer to our repo and a first-pass SOC2 questionnaire (we often ask this up front). If you could propose a slot and confirm who will join from Redwood (AE/SE), that'd be great.

Repo: https://github.com/openforge/core
-- Attachment: openforge-repo-link.txt (text)
-- Attachment: openforge-soc2-questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Linus Park
Senior Maintainer, OpenForge Labs
linus@openforge.dev
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Linus Park <linus@openforge.dev>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: OpenForge: Redwood integration demo & webhook/GHE questions

Hi Linus — really appreciate you signing up and the clear questions. Happy to run a focused session (AE + SE) to cover webhooks, GHE deployment options, and capacity expectations.

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue Jan 18 — 10:00–10:45 PST (18:00–18:45 UTC)
- Tue Jan 18 — 14:00–14:45 PST (22:00–22:45 UTC)
- Wed Jan 19 — 15:00–15:45 PST (23:00–23:45 UTC)

If any of those work I will send a calendar invite. I've looped in Marissa (AE) and Aditya (Solutions Engineer) — Aditya can cover the GHE + webhook technical deep dive.

Quick Q: would you like a short security pre-call (30m) before the demo to walk the SOC2 items? We can do that the week prior.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345

Cheers,
Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — quick update: I just checked our internal calendar and the Jan 18/19 windows collide with a product sprint review. Can we move the demo to early February? Preferable windows (PST):
- Fri Feb 2: 10:00–11:00 PST
- Mon Feb 5: 14:00–15:00 PST

We definitely want Aditya on the call. Also, two compliance notes for the team to prepare:
1) We need clarity on data retention and whether Redwood's hosted API can be scoped to our VPC or a dedicated instance (we're sensitive about CI logs).
2) A few items on the SOC2 questionnaire — I'll reattach the doc with inline notes.

Re-attaching SOC2 Q: openforge-soc2-questionnaire.pdf

—Linus

Hi Linus — Marissa here (AE) — thanks for the context. Feb 2 at 10:00 PST works for our team; we'll plan a 45-minute demo with the following agenda:
- 10m: quick intros & goals
- 20m: live demo (GitHub app, webhooks, GHE patterns)
- 10m: Q&A + next steps (routing, pricing, Dedicated/Private options)

Aditya will lead the technical portion and can answer the SOC2/VPC questions in the pre-call. Would you be open to a short technical pre-call on Wed Jan 31 at 11:00 PST to walk the SOC2 items and confirm any network requirements?

If that works I'll send calendar invites for both the pre-call (Jan 31) and the main demo (Feb 2).
